# ChargeGuard

> ChargeGuard by Qiyadon helps small-to-midsize US trucking carriers document and recover the detention and accessorial charges they are owed, automatically. ChargeGuard applies each broker or shipper's own actual agreed terms to every claim, instead of one generic default rule for every customer.

## Pricing

Tiered flat-rate monthly subscriptions banded by fleet size:
- Starter: $59/month (5-15 trucks), or $49/month billed annually
- Growth: $149/month (16-50 trucks), or $124/month billed annually
- Scale: $349/month (51-150 trucks), or $291/month billed annually

Optional TMS/ELD integration: +$29/month on Starter and Growth, included free on Scale. No long-term contract; month-to-month.
